name: Holiday Inn Cebu City
short_description: A 180-room hotel in the heart of Cebu Business Park, a 5-minute walk from Ayala Center Cebu, and the first Holiday Inn in the Visayas region.
ai_summary: Holiday Inn Cebu City opened on July 1, 2022 as IHG's first Holiday Inn property in the Visayas region, set inside Cebu Business Park, the city's central business district, about a 5-minute walk from Ayala Center Cebu and SM City Cebu. The 180 rooms and suites include a 45-inch LED TV, spacious work desk, and premium bedding, and the hotel runs Sevii Dining & Drinks as its all-day buffet restaurant plus a 7th-floor outdoor pool and 24-hour fitness center. On TripAdvisor it ranks #1 of 351 hotels on Cebu Island at 4 of 5 from over 600 reviews, with guests consistently praising staff service, the buffet breakfast, and the central business-park location.

core_facts.address: Lot 5 and 6, Block 20, Samar Loop, Cebu Business Park, Cebu City 6000, Philippines
elite_benefits: Complimentary hot breakfast for two as a welcome amenity for IHG One Rewards Diamond Elite members, per program terms
Complimentary room upgrades for Platinum Elite and Diamond Elite members, subject to availability
Welcome amenity of points or a drink/snack at check-in for Platinum Elite members, subject to availability

pros: The first Holiday Inn property to open in the Visayas region (July 2022)
Ranked #1 of 351 hotels on Cebu Island on TripAdvisor, rated 4 of 5 from 600+ reviews
Set inside Cebu Business Park, a 5-minute walk from Ayala Center Cebu and SM City Cebu
180 rooms and suites with 45-inch LED TVs and premium bedding
7th-floor outdoor pool with separate shallow and lap sections, plus a 24-hour fitness center
cons: Some guests note standard rooms run compact relative to the rate
City business-park setting means limited walkable beach or heritage sightseeing directly outside the hotel
research_highlights: Guests repeatedly praise the warm, attentive staff service and buffet breakfast at Sevii Dining & Drinks
The Cebu Business Park location keeps Ayala Center Cebu and SM City Cebu within a short walk or drive
TripAdvisor ranks it #1 of 351 Cebu Island hotels, its highest local competitive position
research_watchouts: A subset of reviews mention standard room sizes as compact
As a 2022 opening, some room stock is newer than surrounding competitors, which can shift as the property ages

faqs.question: When did Holiday Inn Cebu City open?
faqs.answer: Holiday Inn Cebu City opened on July 1, 2022, marking IHG Hotels & Resorts' first Holiday Inn property in the Visayas region and its entry into the Cebu market, following an opening promotion for IHG One Rewards members announced in May 2022.

faqs.question: Is Holiday Inn Cebu City close to Ayala Center Cebu?
faqs.answer: Yes -- the hotel sits inside Cebu Business Park, roughly a 5-minute walk from Ayala Center Cebu shopping mall and within a short drive of SM City Cebu, making it a convenient base for both business travelers and leisure visitors exploring the city.
